spec:solubles.kernel_loading_cap.reason: Disabled by the builder for total particle loading: the initial particle concentration is not an equilibrium capacity. model.hydraulics.pore_air_permeability_e.reason: The effective connectivity-to-relative-permeability exponent is a grade D closure (3), not measured for these pucks. Held fixed; the V4 transient, V3 and V5 shot times do not select it.

model.hydraulics.moisture_diffusivity.reason: The pore-air relaxation time uses (D32/2)^2/(pi^2 D), capped at 600 s, with D = 2.5e-11 m^2/s from the independent Mateus moisture-uptake range. model.hydraulics.wetting_uptake.reason: In M1.1 this is the fixed effective-loading normalization inherited from the extraction model, distinct from the full intraparticle water inventory. It is not fitted to startup observations.

extraction.diffusivity.caffeine.particle.reason: Species kernel diffusivities trade off with the coffee's contents (correlation −0.89 to −0.95): their posterior SD was 2–12× the prior's, and free fits drifted 2–5× outside the literature priors (caffeine to 8×10⁻¹¹, trigonelline to the 1×10⁻⁹ bound).
